why: Five HomeRuleMemo statics (ChiefBackend.titles/badges, ChiefNameMemo.harnesses/models, HomeChiefNames.names): process-wide answers of pure Rust rules (HomeRules.call) that Home and sidebar rows ask per row per draw on the main thread (thread p1795759419, cmux#59531's class: 2-6 s hangs at ~1,100 rows). The callers are static functions and String extensions with ~10 call sites and no instance to hold a cache. No app state: each entry is a pure function of its whole input (the language-reading ones keyed also on the app language bundle, so a language switch asks again), lock-guarded, bounded at 256 entries, in memory only.
